page.notes: The initial L of "Libro" is a large woodcut-style letter, joined to the word. The reading "affecti[?] unt[?]" in Libr. II is uncertain. "eos àte" in the line "toto cælo eos àte" is doubtful, as is "ductu". The hyphen-breaks "excogi-tare", "admit-tere" and "nor-mali" are printed at the line ends. The entry "lin.11." is printed as shown.
